title: dorycnium herbaceum subsp. sabaudum
intro: Dorycnium herbaceum subsp. sabaudum, commonly known as Yellow Restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is known to possess several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating various conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Restharrow include its ability to reduce inflammation, protect against oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
